:::{#def-markov-chain}
#### Markov chain of three random variables

[Discrete random variables](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-discrete-rv) $X$, $Y$ and $Z$
form a **Markov chain** $X \to Y \to Z$ [@cover2006elements, section 2.8]
if $X$ and $Z$ are [conditionally independent](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/independence.html#def-cind) given $Y$:
for every value $y$ with $\P(Y=y) > 0$ and all values $x$ and $z$,

$$\P(X=x, Z=z \mid Y=y) = \P(X=x \mid Y=y) \, \P(Z=z \mid Y=y).$$

:::
